questions.stem:
Find the value of *X*, if the perimeter of the figure below (not drawn to scale) is 48 cm.

![figure](asset:q14-stem-fig)
questions.solution:
Perimeter of given figure

= (2 + 9 + 5 + *X* + 2 + *X* + 2 + 9 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 5) cm = (40 + 2*X*) cm

But, perimeter = 48 cm \[Given\] Therefore, (40 + 2*X*) cm = 48 cm

And, 2*X* = 48 – 40 = 8

Or, 2*X* = 8

Hence, *X* = 8 ÷ 2 = 4

questions.stem: A performance began at 19:45. It lasted 1 hour 25 minutes. At what time did it end?
questions.solution:
Time at which performance began = 19 : 45 Duration of performance = 1 hr 25 mins

So, 1 hr 25 mins after 19 : 45 is 21: 10.

Hence, the performance ended at 21 : 10.

questions.stem: Neha had 21 novels. She got two more from her aunt, 12 more on her birthday and bought 3 more with her pocket money. How many novels does she has now?
questions.solution:
Number of novels Neha had = 21

Number of novels she got from her aunt = 2

Number of novels she got on her birthday = 12

Number of novels she bought from her pocket money = 3 Therefore, total number of novels she has now

=(21 + 2 + 12 + 3) = 38

questions.stem: Amit went for a walk and returned home at 7:00 a.m. If it took him 2 hours and 45 minutes, then at what time did he start to walk?
questions.solution:
Time at which Amit returned home = 7:00 a.m. Total duration of the walk = 2 hours 45 minutes

So, 2 hours 45 minutes before 7 :00 a.m. is 4 :15 a.m. Hence, he started to walk at 4 : 15 a.m.

questions.stem: There are 54 balls which are kept into 6 bags such that the number of balls in each bag is equal. How many balls are there in 2 such bags?
questions.solution: Number of balls in 6 bags = 54 Number of balls in 1 bag = 54 ÷ 6 = 9 Number of balls in 2 bags = 9 × 2 = 18

questions.stem: 1 kg of onions costs ₹ 25. If 3 kg of onions cost as much as 5 kg of potatoes, how much will it cost to buy 12 kg each of potatoes and onions altogether ?
questions.solution:
Cost of 1 kg of onions = ₹ 25

Cost of 3 kg of onions = ₹ (25 × 3) = ₹ 75

Cost of 5 kg of potatoes = ₹ 75

Cost of 1 kg of potatoes = ₹ (75 ÷ 5) = ₹ 15

Cost of 12 kg of potatoes = ₹ (15 × 12) = ₹ 180

Also, cost of 12 kg of onions = ₹ (25 × 12) = ₹ 300

Total cost of 12 kg of each of potatoes and onions = ₹ (180 + 300) = ₹ 480

questions.stem: Riya and Richa had an equal number of marbles. Riya gave 35 marbles to Richa and lost 10 marbles. If Riya is left with 25 marbles, then find the total number of marbles Riya and Richa had initially.
questions.solution:
Number of marbles Riya gave to Richa = 35 Number of marbles Riya lost = 10

Number of marbles left with Riya = 25

Total number of marbles Riya had = 35 + 10 + 25 = 70 Therefore, total number of marbles Riya and Richa had initially = 70 + 70 = 140

questions.stem: Vivan bought 6 kg 500 g of wheat from one shop and 3 kg 850 g of wheat from another shop. How much wheat did he buy altogether?
questions.solution:
Quantity of wheat Vivan bought from first shop = 6 kg 500 g = 6500 g

Quantity of wheat he bought from second shop

= 3 kg 850 g = 3850 g

Total quantity of wheat bought by him = (6500 + 3850)g = 10350 g = 10 kg 350 g

questions.stem: A doll costs ₹ 428 more than a teddy bear. If cost of the teddy bear is ₹ ₹ 1290, then how much does the doll cost?
questions.solution:
Cost of a teddy bear = ₹ 1290

Doll costs ₹ 428 more than the teddy bear.

Therefore, cost of the doll = ₹ (1290 + 428) = ₹ 1718

Modern Library has 32436 books of English, 32100 books of Hindi and 25880 books of Mathematics. National Library has 25808 books of English, 32346 books of Science and 32101 books of Mathematics. Which of the following statements is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Modern Library has 150 more books than National Library.

options.label: B
options.text: Both Libraries have the same number of books.

options.label: C
options.text: Modern Library has 157 less books than National Library.

options.label: D
options.text: Modern Library has 161 more books than National Library.

questions.solution:
Total number of books in Modern Library

= 32436 + 32100 + 25880 = 90416

Total number of books in National Library

= 25808 + 32346 + 32101 = 90255

So, Modern Library has (90416 – 90255) = 161 more books than National Library.
